schema_recommendations: Separate Work, Edition/Version, Digital File, Repository Record, and local Catalogue Record entities. Give each a stable URI; do not use the catalogue URL as DOI identity.
Keep a per-field assertion object {value, source_url, retrieved_at, status, note}; preserve original source values and label catalogue-editor additions.

Export Dublin Core Terms: title, alternative, creator, contributor, issued, modified, identifier, bibliographicCitation, publisher, language, type, format, extent, subject, spatial, temporal, rights, license, source, relation, isVersionOf, hasVersion, isPartOf.

Use schema.org Book / ScholarlyArticle for the actual work, CreativeWork for the local catalogue record, Person for creator, Organization for publisher and Periodical for serial. Set mainEntityOfPage and subjectOf deliberately; do not equate every link with sameAs.
Represent DOI, ISBN, ISSN, ORCID as scoped identifiers. Attach serial ISSN to Periodical; edition ISBN to Book; version DOI to that deposited version. URI-normalize ORCID and DOI.

Use provenance fields in JSON export and human-readable Sources & Catalogue Notes; keep local subject groupings distinct from source keywords. Do not claim LCSH / Getty AAT controlled terms until labels and URIs verified.
Treat web-page publication dates, book first-edition year, Zenodo publication date and deposit creation/modified timestamps as distinct fields.

Show exact verified external records as bibliographic links; general search links or inaccessible records must be labelled separately. Preserve original rights per version and third-party image rights.
